test_cases.title: Request a login code
steps: Enter student@example.com and choose Send code.
test_cases.expected: A confirmation says that a four-digit code was sent.

test_cases.title: A wrong code is rejected
test_cases.expected: The server rejects the code and the user stays signed out.

test_cases.title: An expired code is rejected
test_cases.precondition: A code was sent more than ten minutes ago.
steps: Enter the expired code and choose Log in.
test_cases.expected: The server rejects the expired code and the user stays signed out.

test_cases.title: A second code request is rate limited
test_cases.precondition: A code was requested less than 60 seconds ago.
steps: Request another code for the same address.
test_cases.expected: The server says to wait and does not send a second code.

test_cases.title: Create a discussion post
test_cases.expected: The post is created and appears in the discussion list.

test_cases.title: A post with a required field missing is rejected
test_cases.expected: The post is not created and a required-field message appears.

test_cases.title: Read a discussion and its replies
test_cases.precondition: The home screen shows the sample Database Systems post.
test_cases.expected: The discussion page shows the selected post and its replies.

test_cases.title: An unknown discussion is not found
steps: Open a post that does not exist.

test_cases.title: Find a resource by keyword
test_cases.expected: Java OOP resources remain visible and unrelated resources are filtered out.

test_cases.title: Show a message when no resources match
test_cases.expected: No resource cards are shown and a no-results message appears.

test_cases.title: View a student profile
test_cases.expected: The profile shows the sample student's courses and study interests.

test_cases.title: Use the main screens on a phone
test_cases.precondition: The prototype is open in a browser with phone view enabled.
steps: Set the viewport to 390 pixels wide.
Open each main screen and use its controls.
test_cases.expected: No horizontal scrolling or cut-off text appears and each control can be reached.

test_cases.title: Create and join a study group
steps: Create a Database Systems study group.
Find it in the group list.
test_cases.expected: The new study group appears in the list and the student becomes a member.

test_cases.title: Send a message to a study group
test_cases.precondition: The student is a member of the Database Systems group.
steps: Send the message 'I found a useful review sheet.'
test_cases.expected: The message appears in the group's message list.

test_cases.title: The login code is not shown in a response
steps: Inspect the code-request response and application log.
test_cases.expected: The four-digit code appears in neither the response nor the log.
